decisions.reason: This resin injection unit is adjacent to the firm's core application equipment business, so the option still has value, but its more specialized nature and support burden make it only a moderate keep.
Like A, this resin injection unit fits the firm's technical capabilities and customer base, yet as a specialized capital product it is costlier to carry if demand remains uncertain.

An automatic airless spray gun sits close to the firm's established spray technology range, so synergies in production, sales and service make continued market presence relatively cheap and worthwhile.

A manual airless spray gun is highly consistent with the firm's core offer and likely easy to support through existing channels, so the option value of keeping it is high relative to its carrying cost.
Because this is a broader product line with several models in a core spray-gun category, it signals stronger commitment and better reuse of existing capabilities, which argues for retention.

The data logger was downgraded from a standalone page to only a mention by 2019, suggesting weaker traction, and its electronics and software-related support needs make it a stronger candidate to exit.
